sources.title: clip-ViT-B-32: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview clip-ViT-B-32 is a vision-language model that maps text and images to a shared 512-dimensional vector space, enabling retrieval and classification tasks without task-specific training. Maintained by sentence-transformers, this model implements the CLIP architecture using a Vision Transformer-Base with 32×32 patch embeddings for image encoding paired with a transformer text encoder ...

sources.snippet: The contrastive image-text model that underpins modern multimodality: a full 12-block ViT image tower and a full 12-block Transformer text tower projected into one 512-dim space, trained so matching pairs score high by dot product. Stable Diffusion's text encoder is the text half of this design.
